ओड्र: Oḍra, pl. (°āḥ), a people. § 295 (Dyūtap.): II, 51, 1843 (waited upon Yudhiṣṭhira). Cf. Uḍra, pl.
ओघरक्षस्: Ogharakṣas. § 561c (Kṛṣṇa Vāsudeva): V, 48, 1890 (nihatyaugharakṣe Nirmocanaṃ cāpi jagāma, sc. Kṛṣṇa; Oghasaṃjñaṃ rakṣaḥ, Nīl.).
ओघवत्: Oghavat1, a Kuru warrior. § 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 5ζ, 132 (had been slain in the battle).
Oghavat2, a king. § 720b (Sudarśanop.): XIII, 2, 121 (nṛpaḥ, grandfather of Nṛga), 122 (father of Ogharatha and Oghavatī).
ओघवती: Oghavatī1, a river. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9λ, 329.— § 615i (Saptasārasvata): IX, 38α, 2189 (one of the seven Sarasvatīs), 2212 (at the sacrifice of Kuru the river Sarasvatī appeared in Kurukṣetra as the river O.).—§ 615 (Gadāyuddhap.): IX, 62, 3498.—§ 639 (Rājadh.): XII, 50, 1812 (nadīṃ Bhīṣma lay on his arrow bed on the bank of the river O.). Cf. next.

Oghavatī2, daughter of Oghavat2 and wife of Sudarśana. § 720b (Sudarśanop.): XIII, 2, 122, 124 (dwelt in Kurukṣetra), 125, 130, 133, 136, 143 (together with her husband Sudarśana put to the test by Dharma), 168 (with half her body she became the river of the same name). Cf. prec.
ओषधी: Oṣadhī, pl. (°yaḥ) (“plants,” personif. as a class of gods). § 120bis (Aṃśāvat.): I, 66, 2604.—Do.2 = Śiva (1000 names1).
